name: optimize-harness
description: Run a budgeted hill-climbing search over one of PClaw's own templates and file the winner as a proposal. Each candidate is scored against the template's own finished runs; the live template is never written to, a candidate that touches it is dead whatever it scores, and the search stops before it would spend past its dollar budget.

target_template.help: The PClaw template being optimized. Its finished runs (at least three) are what every candidate is scored against, and it is the results.tsv subject its best-ever score is read back under.

live_target.help: The live artifact's path. This and its .pclaw-lock.json are the FROZEN region: read-only for the whole search.

sandbox.help: A throwaway directory for candidates and the .experience/ index. Must be outside the frozen region — preflight refuses otherwise.

budget_usd.help: The hard dollar ceiling. The search measures what its own model calls cost, and stops before its next cycle or scoring would pass this. There is no default: an unbudgeted search over model calls has no ceiling at all.

suite_threshold.help: Half one of the dual gate: the share of the target's runs a candidate must pass, as the eval judge scores them. A candidate below it is discarded even when it beats the best score so far.

hypothesis_abandon_after.help: Halt after this many attempts at the SAME fix that the gate did not admit — at that point the diagnosis is wrong, not the execution.

no_improvement_halt.help: Halt after this many candidates in a row that did not raise the best score.

max_iterations.help: How many candidates the search tries at most, up to 50 — reached only when none of the other halts fires first.

steering_examples.description: Try to improve the code-project template's audit prompt, spend at most two dollars, and show me the best candidate
Stop searching if three candidates in a row fail to beat the current best — do not burn the rest of the budget on a plateau

example_outputs: one template-diff proposal that cleared both the suite threshold and the best score so far, with the score measured on the template's own runs, plus a ledger of every candidate including the discards
no proposal and a sentence naming why the search stopped — its budget, its candidate limit or a plateau — when nothing beat the incumbent
metadata.when_not_to_use: not for editing an artifact directly — this only ever proposes, and every candidate costs model calls: one to propose it and two for each recorded run it is scored against. Reach for `refine-template` when one look at a template's run ledger is enough.
